name: GSG probe on a short standard: contact diagnosis (lossy, a 1 mΩ shorted stub to ground, open receiver)

example.note: The experimental impedance range: 0.5 in of 50 Ω lead, 20 pH of probe-tip and strip inductance, the contact resistance, and a short (a painted 1 mΩ section into a 1 mΩ receiver). Good contact (30 mΩ), bad contact (0.5 Ω), a lifted probe (1 MΩ), and a lossy version shorted to ground by a 1 mΩ shorted stub, with the line running on into an open receiver. Kaiser β 6, 67 GHz.
example.author: TDR Painter validation
